points.quote: Web adds the browser or web variants, such as `contrib/logs/browser/logs.contribution.js`, `contrib/performance/browser/performance.web.contribution.js`
`src/vs/workbench/workbench.common.main.ts` holds the shared dependencies. ... `workbench.desktop.main.ts` and `workbench.web.main.ts` each import the common file.
Where both platforms have the same feature, each side has its own implementation. Each one registers its own singleton service.
The doc says "Only code referenced from entry point files is loaded."
Features register themselves through side-effect imports of their `.contribution.ts` file.
